subject: Mutual Action Plan: kickoff and executive alignment for Acme Cloud evaluation
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Greene <laura.greene@acmecloud.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: kickoff and executive alignment for Acme Cloud evaluation

Hi Laura, Ben —

Thanks for taking the time last week. As discussed on the call, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short evaluation checklist to help us align on stakeholders, success criteria, and a realistic close timeline. High-level asks in this kickoff: 

- Confirm executive sponsor (VP / CTO owner) for the evaluation and the escalation path.
- Agree on the target quarterly outcomes (what success looks like at the end of Q3).
- Identify security/compliance reviewer(s) and procurement contact for contracting steps.
- Pick one of the proposed slots below for a 45-minute cross-functional kickoff next week.

Proposed Q3 outcomes (draft):
- Pilot integration running in staging with 1–2 production-like endpoints
- Latency and cost baseline established (per-token cost, p95 latency)
- Evaluation scorecard: inference quality >= 92% on provided prompts
- Rollout plan and escalation path documented

Attachments included: Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestone dates), Evaluation_Criteria.docx (prompt set + pass/fail thresholds).

Proposed kickoff times (PT): Tue May 4 10:00–10:45, Wed May 5 14:00–14:45, Thu May 6 09:00–09:45. You can also pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/priyom-das/redwood-acme-map-kickoff

Internal owners: Monica Patel (security/compliance lead), Karthik Iyer (commercial escalation contact). If you prefer different owners, let us know and we’ll update the MAP.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning this week.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference — High-performance, production-ready LLM inference

--
Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
Attachment: Evaluation_Criteria.docx (docx stub)

From: Laura Greene <laura.greene@acmecloud.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@acmecloud.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 12:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: kickoff and executive alignment for Acme Cloud evaluation

Thanks, Priyom. Appreciate the clear MAP draft. A few quick notes: 

- Executive sponsor: I will be the technical sponsor at the CTO level for this evaluation. Ben Turner (VP Product) will be the business sponsor — I’ve CC'd him here.
- Procurement: please loop in procurement@acmecloud.com for any contract/legal touches.
- Security/compliance: we’ll need a SOC 2 summary and the standard security questionnaire filled out. Can you send the SOC 2 summary and point person for the questionnaire?
- Timeline: Q3 outcomes look reasonable, but we’d like the pilot in staging by end of June if possible — let us know if that compresses anything on your side.

I can do Wed May 5 14:00 PT for the kickoff.

Laura
Laura Greene
CTO, Acme Cloud
laura.greene@acmecloud.com | +1 (206) 555-0987

Hi Laura —

Thanks for confirming. I’ll be your primary security/compliance contact for the evaluation. Quick notes and resources to unblock the questionnaire and SOC 2 request: 

- Attached: SOC2-Summary.pdf (summary of controls and scope).
- We’ve also filled the standard security questionnaire template previously used with enterprise customers; I can populate the first pass and share for your review next week.
- For the pilot in staging by end of June — that’s feasible from an infra perspective, but we’ll need access to a representative dataset and an initial integration run in the next 3 weeks. Please confirm who on your engineering team will own the sandbox credentials and a sample prompt set.

Escalation: for SLA or timeline exceptions, Karthik Iyer (cc'd) will be the commercial escalation contact; he can authorize burst capacity or contract amendments if needed.

I’ll send the completed security questionnaire and a link to a short compliance readout in a separate email before the kickoff.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Great — thanks everyone. Wed May 5 14:00 PT is confirmed for the 45-minute kickoff. I’ve added a brief agenda to the MAP (milestones, responsibilities, decision gates).

Next steps: 
- Monica will share the questionnaire and SOC 2 summary (thanks).
- Laura / Ben: please confirm the engineering contact for sandbox access and an initial prompt set by Fri May 7.
- Procurement: I’ll share a redline-friendly SOW and a rough commercial term sheet after the kickoff; procurement@acmecloud.com, feel free to reply with any required contract templates.

Meeting link: https://meet.google.com/meet-redwood-acme
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/ACME-2027-042
